catalog.title: Fit a probe
catalog.mac: Research methods: Author request, review inputs, then open execution and evidence. Both CLIs use science interview/draft/publish and the same managed engine.
outputs: Immutable run with pinned inputs, provenance, and inspectable probe evidence.
catalog.restriction: Bounded binary probe workflow. Predictive accuracy is not causal evidence or calibrated probability. Capture uses the Python engine; fitting and evaluation use shared CPU owners. Legacy readers are preserved.

actions.authorityReason: Inspect staged scientific inputs and execution resources without execution or authorship.
Execute a reviewed scientific operation and retain its scientific output type.

access.restriction: Calls the existing route with its existing service role and scientific gates. Request path parameters, query and body remain explicit; this adapter does not change execution topology or retry mutations.

interview.title: Fit a probe
interview.purpose: Fit a reader or classifier from saved activations without loading the base model. Selection data is optional and is reported separately.

fields.label: Fitting activations
fields.help: Choose fit-activations.json from Capture, or a documented activation-dataset v1 file. At least two rows per class; many more independent groups are normally needed.

fields.label: Probe name
fields.help: A short name for the library. The exact saved bytes identify the instrument.

fields.label: Selection activations (optional)
fields.help: Separate selection-activations.json. Scores help you compare manually chosen settings; they are never called final-test accuracy.

fields.label: Classifier family
fields.help: mean-difference-v1: unit difference of class means; linear-logit-v1: regularized linear classifier; mlp-relu-logit-v1: one small ReLU hidden layer.

fields.label: Activation normalization
fields.help: standardize fits per-feature mean and population standard deviation on fitting rows only (constant features use scale 1); none leaves coordinates unchanged.

fields.label: Optimizer steps
fields.help: Fixed full-batch gradient descent steps, up to 10,000. Not used by mean difference. No early stopping on selection or final-test outcomes.

fields.label: Learning rate
fields.help: Positive update size. Reduce if training diverges. Not used by mean difference.

fields.label: Weight regularization
fields.help: Nonnegative penalty: l2/2 times squared weights, with unpenalized biases. Not used by mean difference.

fields.label: Nonlinear hidden units
fields.help: Only the MLP uses this, up to 256 units. More units can overfit small datasets.

fields.label: Initialization seed
fields.help: Local NumPy PCG64 stream for MLP initialization and the optional shuffled-label control.

fields.label: Fit a shuffled-label control
fields.help: Optional separate control fit. Permutes fitting labels; reports accuracy against original labels. Does not replace the ordinary probe.

fields.label: Negative class meaning
fields.help: Label for scores at or below the fixed zero threshold.

fields.label: Positive class meaning
fields.help: Label for scores above zero. Scores are not calibrated probabilities.

interview.claimBoundary: An activation classifier predicts the supplied labels in this population. It does not establish that the model uses the predicted feature causally.
questions: What do the labels mean, and which related examples belong in one group?
Which data are for fitting, choosing settings, and final assessment?
